game_concept: A action defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Moss Library, a ruined library: the tomb cartographer must handle cursed statues while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of chalk marks while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Moss Library: a ruined library
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Library, repeat each round: Remove repeated items from a list of chalk marks while keeping the order. Each round, cursed statues strike the relic vault, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the clean_list value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the relic vault from cursed statues in Moss Library: keep the clean_list meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 31-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: clean_list drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 31-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 4 (applied tier): Duplicate Sweep
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
